move: letters fold up from mirror line, reflection lags a beat, halves breathe
how: A dimmed aurora background, a horizontal axis line and a word split per character into a top half and a scaleY(-1) bottom half fading through a mask. Top letters come from yPercent 105 rotateX -70 opacity 0 with origin at the baseline, staggered 0.06s from the centre (expo.out, 1s, at 2.5%); the reflection does the mirror move at 5.5%. The axis draws scaleX 0 to 1 (expo.inOut). From 30% to 65% letter-spacing opens to 0.12em and the halves drift +/-22px apart (sine.inOut) while the background scales 1 to 1.08 over the whole clip. At 84% the letters fold back into the axis from the edges (expo.in), the axis retracts and side labels fade.
adapt: Change the word, the serif font, the side labels and the background image; keep the 0.06s centre-out stagger, the 0.12s reflection lag and the sine.inOut breathe.
port: mount(el, shot) splits the word into .ch spans in both halves; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entries at 0.025D and 0.055D, breathe 0.3D to 0.65D, exit at 0.84D. Scope selectors to el.
caveats: the background zoom ends at scale 1.08 and jumps back to 1 on loop
letterSpacing tweened on em values relayouts every frame
